messages:
erin: Quick sync postmortem — we need to lock owners and short timelines for the span-loss + bad-aggregation items. Dropping a compact plan, edit inline.

alex: ok, ping me on the consumer backpressure one. I have a config patch ready.

maria: Summary from the postmortem: (1) span-extractor stalls under GC pressure -> lost KV chunks, (2) aggregator double-counts when retries replay same batch, (3) ETL staging lag spikes at peak -> causes delayed metrics.

erin: Proposed actions:
- A: span extractor backpressure handling -> owner: alex -> temp mitigation: bump JVM + increase consumer parallelism -> ETA: 24h for mitigation, 10 business days for robust fix
- B: aggregator idempotency -> owner: maria -> mitigation: add dedupe key (trace,span,batch) + metric -> ETA: PR in 3 days, canary 5 days
- C: staging ETL lag -> owner: sam -> mitigation: tune partition assignment + add lag alert -> ETA: revert bad rollout today, full config tweak in 2 days

leo: I can be backup for A while alex is on PTO next week.

alex: Deploying the JVM bump to staging now (pin GC flags and bump heap). This is temporary; next step is backpressure tokens in the extractor.

deploy-bot: deploy started by alex at 1834612360  span-extractor/jvm-bump -> staging

sam: Rolled back the recent partition assignment change at 1834612405. Staging shows steady lag now. I'll instrument `etl.partition.idle_seconds`.

maria: I'll add `agg.dedupe.hits` and `agg.dedupe.replays` metrics in the PR. Also plan to add a small sliding window store to prevent duplicate increments.

erin: Updated owners + deadlines in the postmortem doc and created a short checklist: A (alex) EOD, A full fix by 2026-04-08; B PR by 2026-03-29, canary 2026-04-02; C revert done, full tune by 2026-03-25.

leo: For the recurring pattern note: this specific GC->span-loss has recurred twice (Jan + Feb). Suggest adding a regression test to chaos that triggers short GC and asserts span coverage. Who owns that?

maria: I'll pick up the chaos regression test. ETA 2 weeks. Will add test + a small dashboard tile showing span kv misses over time.

alex: Also adding a failing-test alert: if span.kv.misses > 0.5% for 5 min, page oncall.

erin: Good. Communications: support asked for a short customer blurb. Draft: "We've mitigated the root causes of recent span and aggregation anomalies; fixes are rolling and we expect normal metrics within 48 hours." I'll send after alex confirms staging.

sam: Logs and snippet linked in the doc (link). Re: ETL lag, I'll add a runbook entry for emergency partition reassign.

erin: Daily 15m checkins for next 3 days at 09:15 to validate telemetry. If blocked ping me. Thanks all :thumbsup:
